text:
maya: Quick heads-up — release train update for this week. We're planning a staggered rollout of v3.5.2 starting Thu 09:00 PT. Freeze window starts Wed 18:00 PT. Key items: canaries, hotpath regressions, and the legacy quant plugin deprecation.

ashok: Ack. Can we keep the canary footprint to 5% and throttle ingest to avoid cache pressure?

maya: Yes — target 5% for canaries. Ops will throttle if token p50 goes above 120ms for more than 3m.

jen: Heads-up: Security policy update — all new model variants must include provenance metadata in the manifest. Applies to Hosted + Dedicated. We published the policy in #eng-security.

sam: Noted. Any changes to rollback gates?

maya: Rollback gates: (1) error rate spike > 1.5% sustained for 10m, (2) tail latency p99 > 2s for 5m, (3) quality regression detected by eval job. If any gate triggers -> automatic fallback to v3.5.1.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: cluster-us-east-1: 1/20 nodes patched, 2% traffic routed. Logs: https://deploys.internal/release/2067890123

ops-bot: Alert channel created: #release-v3-5-2. Oncall rotation for rollout: Jen -> Ashok -> Sam. Please post handover notes.

ashok: I'm going to run a quick compatibility sweep for quantized kernels tonight. If I find any kernel mismatch, I'll open a blocker and tag @maya.

maya: Thanks. Also a reminder — we're removing the old `quant-plugin-v1` on 2026-04-10. If you have pinned images using it, file an exemption with Product.

sam: Can anybody confirm data plane tracing won't be sampled at 100% during canary? We should avoid tracing storm.

jen: Confirmed — sampling set to 5% for canary traffic. Full tracing only on canary nodes for targeted captures.

maya: Postmortem from last week's incident (short summary): transient KV cache eviction caused 30s token spikes for ~7min. Root cause: mis-sized cache config on a single shard. Mitigation: autosizing defaults adjusted and alert added. Full postmortem in #postmortems later today.

ashok: Suggested follow-up: add a canary-specific load test that exercises long prefix chains. I'll sketch a jenkins job.

maya: Actions recap: 1) Freeze Wed 18:00 PT — no schema or infra migrations after this. 2) Canary at 5% Thu 09:00 PT. 3) Rollback gates as listed. 4) Remove quant-plugin-v1 on 2026-04-10. 5) Postmortem published later today. Please ack in thread when you're set. :thumbsup:

jen: Acked.

ashok: Ack.

sam: Ack — prepping load test.
